steps.caption: Profile Guard
steps.narration: This is Profile Guard. It checks your Google listing on a schedule and compares it with the values you approved.

steps.caption: Mode and last check
steps.narration: This listing is in Notify mode, and you can see when it was last checked.

steps.caption: Off, Notify or Lockdown
steps.narration: Notify alerts you to each change. Lockdown also writes your approved value back to Google once a change is found.

steps.caption: The eleven watched fields
steps.narration: Watched fields are the eleven that matter, from business name, phone and website to hours and open status.

steps.caption: Pending changes and history
steps.narration: Below, every change Profile Guard has found on this listing.

steps.caption: Field, time found, source
steps.narration: Each one names the field, when it was found, and the source as Google reports it. Your approved value sits on the left, the detected value on the right.

steps.caption: Approve or reject
steps.narration: Approve takes the new value into your snapshot. Reject writes your approved value back to Google.

steps.caption: Report to Google
steps.narration: For a misleading edit, Report prepares the evidence for Google's official form.

steps.caption: History keeps every change
steps.narration: History keeps every change with its outcome. This phone number change was reverted, and the old and new values stay on record.

steps.caption: GMB Edit Monitor
steps.narration: No Google connection yet? GMB Edit Monitor checks any public listing when you ask it to. It runs on demand and sends no automatic alerts.

steps.caption: Edit History
steps.narration: Choose Edit History to see what changed between checks.

steps.caption: Menu: GMB Edit Monitor
steps.narration: GMB Edit Monitor is in the menu on the left, under Google Business.

steps.caption: Profile Guard: a tab on every location
steps.narration: Profile Guard is a tab on every linked location, under Locations.

youtube.title: Profile Guard in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Profile Guard in ConstructHUB: it checks your Google Business Profile on a schedule, shows each detected change next to the value you approved, lets you approve or reject it, and keeps the history with Google's evidence. GMB Edit Monitor does on-demand checks of any public listing.
